sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 569 was established by Ordinance No. 24183, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 9, 2000. Ordinance No. 24183 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 569 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Northhaven Road and Valleydale Drive. The size of PD 569 is approximately 20.99 acres. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For community service center, private school, child-care facility, private recreation center, club or area, office, and museum uses, use and development of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 569A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other permitted uses, the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to development, site, or landscape plans do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163; 25938)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Agricultural uses.

-- Crop production.

(b) Commercial and business service uses.

-- None permitted.

(c) Industrial uses.

-- Temporary concrete or asphalt batching plant. [By special authorization of the building official.]

(d) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Adult day care facility. [SUP] -- Cemetery or mausoleum. [SUP] -- Child-care facility. -- Church. -- College, university, or seminary. [SUP] -- Community service center. -- Convent or monastery. [SUP] -- Foster home. [SUP] -- Museum. -- Private school, limited to kindergarten and limited to a maximum of 30 classrooms.

(e) Lodging uses.

-- None permitted.

(f) Miscellaneous uses.

-- Carnival or circus (temporary). [By special authorization of the building official.] -- Temporary construction or sales office.

(g) Office uses.

-- Office.

(h) Recreation uses.

-- Country club with private membership. [SUP] -- Private recreation center, club, or area. -- Public park, playground, or golf course.

(i) Residential uses.

-- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [SUP required if spacing component of Section 51A-4.209 is not met.] -- Single family.

(j) Retail and personal service uses.

-- None permitted.

(k) Transportation uses.

-- Private street or alley. [SUP] -- Transit passenger shelter. [See Section 51A-4.211.]

(l) Utility and public service uses.

-- Electrical substation. [SUP] -- Local utilities. -- Police or fire station. [SUP]

-- Radio, television, or microwave tower. [SUP] -- Tower/antenna for cellular communication. [See Section 51A-4.212.] -- Utility or government installation other than listed. [SUP]

(m) Wholesale, distribution, and storage uses.

-- Recycling drop-off container. [SUP required if the requirements of Subparagraph (E) of Section 51A-4.213 are not met.] -- Recycling drop-off for special occasion collection. [SUP required if the requirements of Subparagraph (E) of Section 51A-4.213 are not met.] (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Front yard.

(1) For community service center, private school, child-care facility, office, private recreation center, club, or area, and museum uses, minimum front yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) For all other uses permitted, minimum front yard is 35 feet.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) For community service center, private school, child-care facility, office, private recreation center, club, or area, and museum uses, minimum side and rear yard is as shown on the development plan.

(2) For all other uses permitted, minimum side and rear yard for single family structures is 10 feet; minimum side yard for other permitted structures is 15 feet; and minimum rear yard for other permitted structures is 20 feet.

(c) Density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is 0.4.

(e) Height.

(1) If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion of a structure may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A- 4.408(a)(2) may project through the residential proximity slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the residential proximity slope, whichever is less. Sports field lighting is exempt.

(2) For community service center, private school, child-care facility, office, private recreation center, club, or area, and museum uses, unless further restricted under Paragraph (1), maximum structure height is as specified on the development plan. Where no height is specified on the development plan, maximum structure height is 36 feet.

(3) For all other permitted uses, unless further restricted under Paragraph (1), maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(4) Unless further restricted under Paragraph (1), in areas where the maximum structure height is 36 feet or less, structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project up to 12 feet above the maximum structure height.

(f) Lot coverage.

(1) Maximum lot coverage is 40 percent.

(2) Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not included in lot coverage calculations.

(g) Lot size. Minimum lot size for residential uses is 16,000 square feet.

(h) Stories.

(1) For community service center, private school, child-care facility, office, private recreation center, club, or area, and museum uses, maximum number of stories above grade is three.

(2) For all other permitted uses, no maximum number of stories above grade. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) If a community service center, private school, child-care facility, private recreation center, club, or area, office, or museum use is operated on the Property, 612 off-street parking spaces, or the off-street parking and loading requirements of Division 51A-4.200, whichever is greater, must be provided.

(b) For all other permitted uses, consult the use regulations contained in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(c) Consult Division 51A-4.300 for regulations governing off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163; 25938)

sections.title: Special Fence
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.109. SPECIAL FENCE.

A “special fence” must be constructed as shown on the development plan. The fence must have no pedestrian openings and must be constructed with only one fire hydrant emergency access point for fire department use only. The special fence must be constructed upon receiving a building permit for any floor area in Area A. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163; 25938)

sections.title: Construction Vehicles
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.110. CONSTRUCTION VEHICLES.

No construction vehicles may enter the site from Northhaven Road. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping on artificial lots.

(1) For purposes of this district, an artificial lot must include any new building footprint and at least 25 feet around the footprint. An artificial lot does not require public street frontage.

(2) The aggregate land area of all artificial lots may not exceed 50 percent of the total land area in this district.

(3) For community service center, private recreation center, club, or area, private school, child-care facility, office, and museum uses, a landscape plan for the artificial lot that meets the following requirements must be submitted with each application for a building permit:

(A) Minimum six-foot-high solid screening for off-street loading must be provided to screen off-street loading areas from adjacent property and public streets and alleys. Screening must be constructed of materials outlined in Section 51A-4.602.

(B) One site tree, a minimum of three-inch caliper in size, must be provided for each 4,000 square feet of land area in the artificial lot. For purposes of this subparagraph, required site trees are permitted anywhere on the Property.

(C) No surface parking space may be located more than 120 feet from the trunk of a large canopy tree.

(D) A minimum of two design standards must be complied with as outlined in Section 51A-10.126.

(b) All plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.113. SIGNS.

(a) Five monument signs are permitted at the locations shown on the development plan. No sign may exceed 80 square feet in effective area or five feet in height.

(b) Except as provided in Subsection (a), signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163; 25938)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.114. ACCESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(c) In this district, a lot for a single family use may be supplied by not more than one electrical utility service, and metered by not more than one electrical meter. The board of adjustment may grant a special exception to authorize more than one electrical utility service and more than one electrical meter on a lot in this district when, in the opinion of the board, the special exception will:

(1) not be contrary to the public interest;

(2) not adversely affect neighboring properties; and

(3) not be used to conduct a use not permitted in this district.

(d) No loading dock may be located within 150 feet of the south line of Northaven Road. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-569.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 569 is located on Zoning Map No. E-8. (Ord. Nos. 24183; 25163)
